title: Hi all, I created a tool EZ AI Filter for anti AI folks to scan and display games with voluntary AI disclosures so they don't have to check each game out individually since they wont be buying them anyways.
author: yapdakilla81
selftext:
Works on Steam/Itch/Epic/GOG websites and apps.



Check out [https://ycfproductions.itch.io/ez-ai-filter](https://ycfproductions.itch.io/ez-ai-filter)



Steam version in the works
